crossRefs.note: Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God, being…
The night is far gone, and the day is near. Let’s therefore throw off the deeds of darkness, and let’s put on the armor…
Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,
For consider him who has endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, that you don’t grow weary, fainting in…
May it never be! We who died to sin, how could we live in it any longer?
For he who has died has been freed from sin.
Thus consider yourselves also to be dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord.
I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me. That life which I now live…
Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts.
For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.
Wash yourselves. Make yourself clean. Put away the evil of your doings from before my eyes. Cease to do evil.
They will burn your houses with fire, and execute judgments on you in the sight of many women. I will cause you to…
For he who has entered into his rest has himself also rested from his works, as God did from his.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Therefore, since Christ suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves also with the same mind; for he who has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin,
translations.bsb: Therefore, since Christ suffered in His body, arm yourselves with the same resolve, because anyone who has suffered in his body is done with sin.
translations.kjv: Forasmuch then as Christ hath suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves likewise with the same mind: for he that hath suffered in the flesh hath ceased from sin;
translations.asv: Forasmuch then as Christ suffered in the flesh, arm ye yourselves also with the same mind; for he that hath suffered in the flesh hath ceased from sin;
